feeding_claim.verbatim: Our cattle spend most of their lives on grass, then finish on a high-quality grain blend during their last stretch.

pickup_locations: Meetups in nearby cities, arranged when ordering

notes: Black Angus raised on the family's 360-acre farm on the Mulberry River, but calves are bought from neighboring Cullman County farms, then grown on grass and finished on grain on the farm. Orders by phone or Facebook message; no online store. Delivers and arranges pickup across North and Central Alabama (towns listed). Quarter, half and whole freezer beef with cut sheet. Says select restaurants carry the beef, none named. No shipping.
